summary: Frontend E2E for Receipt Log + Hosted Receipt: all 5 requested scenarios PASS. Logged in as super admin, switched to Acme, created a mock sandbox payment WITH customer_email=finance@vortexglobal.info (UITEST-1788445278, $23.45) — succeeded. Payment Details dialog renders receipt-log with email, status badge 'Sent', receipt-log-time 'Sent 9/3/2026, 2:21:20 PM', and receipt-log-link pointing to /receipt/ZqqAIW-9rHAXOPM3Y8eWuxtnVf-rAvwZ. Routing & Failover Trace (data-testid=routing-trace) still renders alongside the new section (regression OK). Created a payment WITHOUT customer email (UITESTNO-1788445278) — Details shows receipt-log-none note and NO receipt-log-status badge, NO receipt-log wrapper. Hosted public receipt page loads without authentication (cookies not required by route) and shows public-receipt-page, receipt-amount=$23.45, receipt-reference=UITEST-1788445278, receipt-status='Payment successful', receipt-print-button, merchant 'Acme Commerce', and support_email link. Invalid token (/receipt/some-invalid-token-xyz-123) cleanly renders receipt-error 'Receipt not found' with no crash and no public-receipt-page. Existing Payments row actions (Details/Capture/Void/Refund) unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: ReceiptPage.jsx uses api client with credentials — works because public endpoint ignores auth; verified no-auth access succeeds and invalid token yields graceful 'Receipt not found' error state.
Payments.jsx receipt-log block correctly hides status badge and full log wrapper when customer_email is null (receipt-log-none path). Good gating.

receipt-log-link uses relative /receipt/{token} and opens same-tab. Spec says 'in a new tab'. The href is a plain <a> without target='_blank' — minor UX note; functionally reachable in a new tab via right-click or ctrl-click. Not a blocker; consider adding target='_blank' rel='noopener' for the spec's 'new tab' expectation.
seed_data_creation: Two Acme test payments created via mock provider: UITEST-1788445278 (with email, succeeded, receipt sent) and UITESTNO-1788445278 (no email, succeeded, no receipt).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live evidence captured: receipt token ZqqAIW-9rHAXOPM3Y8eWuxtnVf-rAvwZ resolves publicly. Only cosmetic finding: 'View receipt' link in the operator dialog lacks target='_blank'; opens same tab. Everything else matches spec verbatim.
